brief:
Israeli forces injured a Palestinian man with a rubber-coated bullet during a raid on the Qalandiya refugee camp in the occupied West Bank, Al Jazeera reported. The operation resulted in 27 additional arrests across the territory.

No further details were provided about the circumstances of the raid, the identities of those arrested, or the extent of the injured man's wounds.
